en: When you love someone, you lose your freedom.

text:
누군가를 사랑하면서
내 자유를 찾는다는 것은
en: Holding on to your freedom while you love
is impossible. That isn't love.

text:
사랑하는 사람이 있는데
일주일 연락이 없어
en: Someone you love goes silent for a week.

text:
갔더니 어디 해외로
여행 갔다 왔대
en: Turns out they went on a trip abroad.
"Why didn't you call? I was worried."
"My life is mine, your life is yours,

text:
왜 내가 너한테
연락을 해야 되느냐"
en: so why should I have to call you?"
If they say that, break up.
You have to break up.
Because how could love
not limit you?
Love costs you control.

text:
상대를 기쁘게 해주려는
마음이 간절한 탓에
en: You want so badly to make them happy

text:
상대의 불행한 모습은
견디기 힘든 형벌과 같아서
en: that their unhappiness feels like punishment,
and you become a kind of slave.
Love makes you a slave.

text:
그 사람이 아픈 것이
너무 힘들어요
en: When they hurt, you can hardly bear it.
Love is connection;
there's no isolated self in love.
